    A 2D synthetic benchmark function using a Radial Basis Function (RBF) network
    with added skew and linear bias for targeted ELA features. The RBF network
    creates multiple local minima and rugged features.

    f(x) = rbf_network + skew_term + linear_term

    where, rbf_network = sum(amplitude_i * exp(-||x - center_i||^2 / (2 * sigma_i^2))) for i in [1, 2, 3]
           skew_term =  0.05*((x[0] + x[1])**2 if (x[0] + x[1] > 0 and x[0] + x[1] < 2) else 0)  # Skewed term
           linear_term = 0.1*x[0] + 0.05*x[1]
    """
    x = np.asarray(x)

    centers = np.array([[1, 1], [-1, -1], [2, -1]]) + np.array([[0.1, 0.2], [-0.1, 0.1],[0,0.2]])*np.sin(x[0]+x[1])
    amplitudes = np.array([1, -0.8, 0.5])
